name: fabric-dashboards
description: Fabric Dashboards (PassionCode.ai): finds, watches and controls every local agent service on this Mac that speaks fabric-service/0.1.

scripts.build:main: npm run build:host && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=out/main/electron/preload.js --log-level=warning
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:host && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:host && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts packages/service-host/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/e2e/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/check-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-regions.mjs && python3 docs/ux/lint.py
